subject.why: The illustration clearly depicts a chunky rolled-open star map scroll with stellar navigation markings and a ringed planet.

category.why: The object floats in the air with a slight tilt on a solid gradient background with a repeated theme motif, perfectly matching Category 1.

clean.why: There are no letters, numbers, text, UI elements, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The scroll is well-centered with ample margins on all sides and a chunky, readable silhouette.

colour.why: The palette is saturated and vibrant, featuring a warm cream scroll and bright blue accents set against the planned rich violet-purple background.

detail.why: Shapes are clean, simplified, and bold, with no distracting micro-textures, noise, or unnecessary props.

style.why: The rendering features smooth chunky volumes, soft satin sheen, and clean bevels matching the reference style perfectly.

bg_colour.why: background is purple (100% of the background); planned purple
